datasets.title: Damage assessment over Kardashynka Village, Kokhany Village and surroundings, Khersonskyi Region, Khersonska Oblast, Ukraine as of 07 June 2023
datasets.description: UNOSAT code FL20230606UKR This map illustrates satellite-detected flood waters and affected structures over Kardashynka and Kokhany Villages and surroundings in Khersonska Oblast (Ukraine) as detected from a WorldView-3 image acquired on 7 June 2023 at 08:19 UTC; and ICEYE image acquired on 7 June 2023. Within the analysed area of 27 km², about 81% (22 km²) of Kardashynka Village, and Kokhany Village and surrounding area appears to be flooded. 8,728 structures and 38 harbours are affected. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-over-kardashynka-village-kokhany-village-and-surroundings-khersonskyi-re]
datasets.details: This is a preliminary assessment and has not yet been validated in the field. It is important to consider the characteristics of the source imagery used in the analyses when interpreting results. For damage assessments it should be noted that only significant damage to the structural integrity of the buildings analyzed can be seen in imagery, while minor damage such as cracks or holes may not be visible at all. For flood extractions using radar data it is important to note that urban areas and highly vegetated areas may mask the flood signature and result in underestimation of flood waters. Users with specific questions or concerns should contact unosat@unitar.org to seek clarification.

lineage.description: UNOSAT analysts compared WorldView-3 optical imagery and ICEYE synthetic aperture radar imagery acquired on 7 June 2023 to detect flood waters and identify affected structures through change detection analysis. Building footprints and harbor locations were mapped and classified as affected or unaffected based on inundation extent, producing a preliminary damage assessment for Kardashynka and Kokhany Villages in Khersonska Oblast.
